title: Sharp feature-learning transitions and Bayes-optimal neural scaling laws in extensive-width networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.10395v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the information-theoretic limits of learning a one-hidden-layer teacher network with hierarchical features from noisy queries, in the context of knowledge transfer to a smaller student model. We work in the high-dimensional regime where the teacher width $k$ scales linearly with the input dimension $d$ -- a setting that captures large-but-finite-width networks and has only recently become analytically tractable. Using a heuristic leave-one-out decoupling argument, validated numerically throughout, we derive asymptotically sharp characterizations of the Bayes-optimal generalization error and individual feature overlaps via a system of closed fixed-point equations. These equations reveal that feature learnability is governed by a sequence of sharp phase transitions: as data grows, teacher features become recoverable sequentially, each through a discontinuous jump in overlap. translated_title: 广延宽度网络中的尖锐特征学习转变与贝叶斯最优神经标度律
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在向更小的学生模型进行知识迁移的背景下，从带噪查询中学习具有层级特征的单隐层教师网络的信息论极限。我们工作在教师宽度 $k$ 与输入维度 $d$ 呈线性标度的高维区间内——这一设定刻画了宽度较大但有限的网络，并且直到最近才在解析上变得可处理。借助一种启发式的留一解耦论证（并在全过程中通过数值验证），我们通过一组封闭的不动点方程，推导出了贝叶斯最优泛化误差和各个特征重叠的渐近精确刻画。这些方程揭示了特征可学习性由一系列尖锐的相变所支配：随着数据量的增长，教师特征被依次恢复，每次恢复都表现为重叠的不连续跳变。这种顺序获取机制构成了精确的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文利用留一解耦论证与封闭不动点方程，在高维广延宽度设定下首次给出贝叶斯最优泛化误差的渐近精确刻画，并揭示教师特征随数据量增长依次通过不连续跳变被学习的尖锐相变序列及其背后的神经标度律。
en_tdlr: The paper derives asymptotically sharp characterizations of the Bayes-optimal generalization error for extensive-width teacher networks via a leave-one-out decoupling argument and closed fixed-point equations, revealing a sequence of sharp, discontinuous feature-learning phase transitions that underlie neural scaling laws.
